findings.description:
Missing null guard on resource returned by getResourceTypeResource can cause a NullPointerException — WHAT: `resource` is used without checking if `AdminPermissionsSchema.SCHEMA.getResourceTypeResource(...)` returned `null`.
WHY: If the `Clients` resource type resource does not exist in the resource server, `getResourceTypeResource` returns `null`, causing a `NullPointerException` when calling `authz.getStoreFactory().getPolicyStore().findByResource(server, resource)` or `resource.getScopes()`.
HOW: Add a `null` check on `resource` before querying policies by resource.

Logical AND (`&&`) is used instead of logical OR (`||`) when determining `isTeamAdminOrOwner`. — WHAT: Logical AND (`&&`) is used instead of logical OR (`||`) when checking team membership permissions in `isTeamAdminOrOwner`.
WHY: Team members hold distinct roles (`ADMIN` or `OWNER`), so requiring both checks to return true causes `isTeamAdminOrOwner` to evaluate to `false`, incorrectly rejecting team owners and team admins with a FORBIDDEN error.
HOW: Change the `&&` operator to `||` so that either team admins or team owners are authorized.

Unescaped hyphen range in regex matches path separators and corrupts englishFile path when directory names contain underscores — WHAT: The regex character class `[a-zA-Z-_]` contains an unescaped range `-_` (ASCII 45 to ASCII 95), which includes path separators (`/`) and dots.

WHY: If `file.getAbsolutePath()` contains an underscore in any parent directory name (such as common CI workspace paths like `_work`), the regex matches across path separators and strips the directory structure, resulting in an invalid path and a `FileNotFoundException` when opening the English properties file.

HOW: Place the hyphen at the end of the character class or escape it (`[a-zA-Z_\\-]`) to prevent it from forming a range that matches `/`.

Device key is cached before CreateOrUpdateDevice succeeds, causing subsequent requests from a blocked device to bypass the device limit. — WHAT: `tagDeviceUI` caches the device key in `localCache` before verifying or updating the device in `CreateOrUpdateDevice`.
WHY: When `CreateOrUpdateDevice` fails with `ErrDeviceLimitReached`, the device key remains in `localCache`, causing subsequent requests for that device within the cache TTL to hit the cache, return `nil`, and bypass the configured anonymous device limit.
HOW: Populate `localCache` with `a.localCache.SetDefault(key, struct{}{})` only after `s.anonStore.CreateOrUpdateDevice(ctx, device)` completes successfully.

Premature cache insertion on error in tagDeviceUI allows subsequent requests to bypass device limit checks. — Fix tagDeviceUI caching behavior to prevent premature cache insertion on error, which allows subsequent requests to bypass device limit checks.

Storage.Create failure incorrectly records metrics via recordLegacyDuration instead of recordStorageDuration — WHAT: recordLegacyDuration is invoked when d.Storage.Create fails.
WHY: Storage failure metrics are recorded against the legacy storage histogram instead of the unified storage histogram, corrupting metrics and alerting.
HOW: Change the call on line 45 to d.recordStorageDuration(true, mode3Str, options.Kind, method, startStorage).

Delete passes the object name instead of options.Kind as the kind label to recordStorageDuration — WHAT: The resource instance name is passed instead of options.Kind as the kind label argument to recordStorageDuration.
WHY: Passing object instances names corrupts metric label dimensionality and causes cardinality explosion in Prometheus for the 'kind' label.
HOW: Pass options.Kind instead of name to recordStorageDuration on line 106.

Storage.Update failure incorrectly records metrics via recordLegacyDuration instead of recordStorageDuration — WHAT: recordLegacyDuration is invoked when d.Storage.Update fails.
WHY: Unified storage update failures are recorded as legacy storage metrics, masking unified storage errors and polluting legacy error metrics.
HOW: Change the call on line 129 to d.recordStorageDuration(true, mode3Str, options.Kind, method, startStorage).

Legacy DeleteCollection asynchronous execution incorrectly calls recordStorageDuration instead of recordLegacyDuration — WHAT: recordStorageDuration is called inside the async Legacy.DeleteCollection goroutine instead of recordLegacyDuration.
WHY: Legacy delete-collection duration and error metrics are recorded into the unified storage metric series instead of the legacy storage series.
HOW: Change line 166 to call d.recordLegacyDuration(err != nil, mode3Str, options.Kind, method, startLegacy).

Unchecked call to `i.content.scrub` raises `NoMethodError` when RSS feed items do not contain a `<content>` element. — WHAT: `i.content.scrub` is called without guarding against `nil` or falling back to `i.description`.
WHY: In standard RSS feeds that use `<description>` rather than `<content>` / `<content:encoded>`, `i.content` returns `nil`, raising `NoMethodError: undefined method 'scrub' for nil:NilClass` and aborting feed polling.
HOW: Fall back to `i.description` when `i.content` is blank, and ensure the string is present before calling `.scrub`.

Mutating `contents` in-place with `<<` raises `NoMethodError` if `contents` is `nil`. — WHAT: `contents << ...` mutates `contents` in-place with `<<` without verifying it is a non-nil string.
WHY: When `import_remote` is called and readability fails to extract content (`doc.content` is `nil`), `contents << ...` raises `NoMethodError: undefined method '<<' for nil:NilClass`.
HOW: Use string interpolation `contents = "#{contents}\n..."` or ensure `contents` is initialized as a string.

`AssignmentSource.queued` evaluates `timezone.now()` at class definition time instead of per-instance instantiation. — WHAT: The `queued` field default is evaluated once at module load time (`timezone.now()`) rather than per-instance creation.
WHY: All `AssignmentSource` instances created using the default value receive the stale timestamp of module import time rather than when the assignment was queued.
HOW: Use `field(default_factory=timezone.now)` so `timezone.now()` is invoked dynamically whenever a new `AssignmentSource` is instantiated.

Dataclass default for `queued` is evaluated at class definition time rather than instance creation. — WHAT: The `queued` field default is evaluated once at module import time (`timezone.now()`) rather than per-instance creation.
WHY: Every `AssignmentSource` instance created without specifying `queued` will share the same stale timestamp from when the module was imported.
HOW: Use `field(default_factory=timezone.now)` from `dataclasses` so `timezone.now()` is called dynamically when an instance is instantiated.
